text.aria-label: Title text 'Demand steps up at about 01:00 on cold winter nights; pooled over the six decision series the step is 10 points'
text.tspan: Demand steps up at about 01:00 on cold winter nights; pooled over the
six decision series the step is 10 points

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Dot: estimate for winters 2021-22 to 2024-25. Line: 90% interval. The six decision substations were set before any fit as the ones the conclusion rests on; the eight further substations (E7-X) were added as a check. Pooled rows average the substations' steps, weighted by how precisely each is known, with a Hartung-Knapp interval. Other rows: resampling 14-day blocks of nights. One point is 1% of the substation's 99th percentile of demand. The step is the rise from 22:00-23:30 to 00:30-03:00 on a night with daily mean 3 C, minus the same rise in summer.'
text.tspan: Dot: estimate for winters 2021-22 to 2024-25. Line: 90% interval. The six decision
substations were set before any fit as the ones the conclusion rests on; the eight further
substations (E7-X) were added as a check. Pooled rows average the substations' steps,
weighted by how precisely each is known, with a Hartung-Knapp interval. Other rows:
resampling 14-day blocks of nights. One point is 1% of the substation's 99th percentile of
demand. The step is the rise from 22:00-23:30 to 00:30-03:00 on a night with daily mean 3 C,
minus the same rise in summer.
